data.title: Listing Committee Upholds Decision to Suspend Goldstone Capital Shares
data.description:
Youth Champ Financial Group Holdings Limited ( (HK:1160) ) just unveiled an announcement.

The Listing Committee upheld the Stock Exchange’s decision to suspend trading in Goldstone Capital Group’s shares after finding that the company had not maintained sufficient operations and assets of sufficient value to support its operations under Rule 13.24. The decision followed a 10 November 2026 hearing and was communicated to the company on 18 November 2026.

During the five-year review period, the company’s financial assets ranged from nil to HK$6.6 million at year-end and consisted mainly of short-term U.S. treasury bills and debt securities, with no evidence of active investment activities or portfolio management. The Listing Committee also found that the company lacked the established management and operational infrastructure necessary for a substantive investment operation.

data.title: Moon Inc. Proposes Convertible Notes Redemption Amendment
data.description:
An announcement from HK Asia Holdings Limited ( (HK:1723) ) is now available.

Moon Inc. entered into deeds with each convertible noteholder on 18 November 2026 to amend its convertible notes from non-redeemable to redeemable, in whole or in part, at the company’s option before maturity, subject to the amendment terms. The outstanding principal amount is HK$52,377,600, while all other terms remain unchanged.

The company cited restoring financial flexibility and removing a restriction on issuing new shares below the HK$5 conversion price without noteholder consent as reasons for the amendment. The change requires Stock Exchange approval under Rule 28.05 and will take effect on the later of that approval date and the relevant deed date.

data.title: Chinlink Discloses Legal Action Against Controlling Shareholder
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Chinlink International Holdings Limited ( (HK:0997) ).

Chinlink International Holdings Limited said its controlling shareholder, Wealth Keeper International Limited, and executive director and ultimate controlling shareholder Li Weibin received a Hong Kong High Court writ on 18 November 2026, issued by Emperor Securities Limited over a claim of approximately HK$438,878,000 in outstanding principal and accrued interest. The claim relates to a 30 June 2015 loan agreement and supplemental thereto, with Wealth Keeper as borrower and Li as guarantor.

Li is interested in approximately 59.96% of Chinlink’s issued shares, including 647,698,560 shares held by Wealth Keeper, of which 635,453,662 shares, or approximately 54.35%, are pledged to Emperor Securities as collateral. The securities company may enforce the pledged shares, which may result in a change of control depending on the number sold and transferees; Wealth Keeper and Li are seeking legal advice.
